title: Comparison of quotient lines along a fixed generator-normalized Proj map
statement:
Let $g:X\to S$ be a scheme morphism, $E$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-module
with quasi-coherent tensor pullback $g^*E$ [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-coherent,
def-pc-module-pullback]. Put $A=A_S(E)$ and $A'=A_X(g^*E)$
[def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra]. Fix normalized tautological quotients
$D$ on $\operatorname{Proj}_S A$ and $D'$ on $\operatorname{Proj}_X A'$
[def-per-projective-bundle-quotient-data]. Fix coefficientwise pullback data $b$ from
$A$ to $A'$ [def-nagata-graded-algebra-pullback-data], whose every affine component
sends $\iota(m)$ to $\iota((1\otimes m)|_W)$. Let $j$ be its specified relative-Proj
comparison [prop-nagata-relative-proj-functoriality]. Write $p$ and $p'$ for their
structural projections [def-nagata-relative-proj]. There is an isomorphism
$w:j^*D.\mathrm{line}\simeq D'.\mathrm{line}$ preserving the pulled quotient, using
the section-normalized pullback composition. Fix a proof $e$ of the equality
$(p\circ j)^*E=(g\circ p')^*E$ of module objects induced by b.isPullback. The
compatibility uses $\operatorname{eqToIso}(e)$; any proof gives the same transport
by proof irrelevance. The quotients and b are inputs; no existence or pullback-square
assertion is included in the conclusion.

proof.text: Obtain a common local frame atlas for the pulled quotient line and the new quotient line, with equal transition relations and matching local coefficients for q and q prime.

Apply the proved source-library Scheme.Modules.isoOfIsFreeGenerator to the cover, free frames and common transition relations. This constructs an isomorphism w sending each restricted frame s_i to t_i. For any section m on an open V, restrict to U_i intersect V. The common coefficient c supplied by the atlas gives w(q(m))=w(c s_i)=c t_i=q prime(m). Naturality of the module morphisms and sheaf uniqueness yield equality on V. Scheme.Modules.hom_ext then proves the required equality of morphisms. These steps are implemented in the proved private helper iso_of_common_frame_coefficients.

For fixed normalized tautological quotients on relative Proj, their line bundles are isomorphic along a coefficient base change and the isomorphism preserves the universal quotient

theorem quotient_comparison_of_normalized_pullbackData
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ S) (E : S.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    [((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E).IsQuasicoherent]
    (D : ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.TautologicalQuotient E)
    (D' : ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.TautologicalQuotient
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E))
    (b : Scheme.GradedAlgebraData.PullbackData g (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E)
      (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E)))
    (hb : ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) (W : X.affineOpens) (h : W.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      (m : E.val.obj (op U.1)),
      b.map h (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Γ(S, U.1) _ m) =
        SymmetricAlgebra.ι Γ(X, W.1) _
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSection g E U.1 m)))
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
        (b.relProjComparison ≫ (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom)).obj E =
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
        ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E)).relProjHom ≫ g)).obj E) :
    ∃ w : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback b.relProjComparison).obj D.line ≅ D'.line,
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSectionComp b.relProjComparison
        (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom).hom.app E ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback b.relProjComparison).map D.quotient ≫ w.hom =
        (eqToIso e).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSectionComp
          (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E)).relProjHom g).hom.app E ≫
          D'.quotient
